# International Journal of Humanities and Social Science

> A peer-reviewed, open-access academic journal publishing original research in humanities and social sciences through the Brooklyn Research and Publishing Institute.

IJHSS is a scholarly journal managed by BRPI that welcomes global submissions across humanities and social science disciplines. The journal maintains rigorous peer-review standards, transparent publication policies, and commitment to open-access scholarship.

## Key Topics

- peer-review
- open-access
- academic publishing
- humanities
- social science
